verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a public REST API, such as the POST /v1/request/query endpoint for querying requests, and publishes an OpenAPI spec at swagger.json, so programmatic access is real. However, nothing in the pack shows that the API matches the UI. Prompt authoring is described as happening in the Playground, and alerts, sessions views and dashboards have no documented API equivalents. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for prompt creation and versioning, alert and webhook configuration, dashboards and analytics; an explicit API-parity statement; independent hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
